source_title: Ranji Trophy 2026-27 points table — Vidarbha, Hyderabad, Bengal, Mumbai lead the way after Round 3 - Sportstar
source_excerpt:
Vidarbha defeated Goa by an innings to extend its lead at the top of Group A. | Photo Credit: PTI
The Ranji Trophy 2026-27 Round three fixtures concluded on Thursday, October 29.
Forty-two time champion Mumbai, Vidarbha, and Karnataka secured innings victories, Tamil Nadu and Bengal won by comfortable margins, while Hyderabad, Punjab, Delhi and Jharkhand settled for draws
After round three, Vidarbha, Hyderabad, Mumbai, and Bengal top their respective groups. Vidarbha leads the way in Group A with 19 points, ahead of Baroda and Uttar Pradesh.
Hyderabad and Bengal top Group B and C respectively, while while Mumbai, leader of Group C, is the only team to take home maximum points after three games.
The Siddhesh Lad led-side has pocketed 21 points as a result of securing three bonus points following innings victories over Chandigarh and Himachal Pradesh and a ten-wicket win over Haryana on Thursday.
Defending champion Jammu and Kashmir eked out a draw against Baroda after being behind the eight ball for most of the contest. The Paras Dogra led-side, which is still searching for its first win of the campaign, sits fifth in Group A with two points.
